definitions.explanation: A unit of volume equal to one thousandth of a liter. Used as both a noun and a counter after numerals.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}を{１|ひゃく}{００|ひゃく}ミリリットル{入|い}れる。
このペットボトルは{５|ご}{００|ひゃく}ミリリットル{入|い}りだ。
{薬|くすり}は{食後|しょくご}に{１|じゅう}{０|ご}ミリリットルずつ{飲|の}んでください。
examples.english: Please take 10 milliliters of the medicine after each meal.

notes:
Loanword from English "milliliter." Abbreviated as ml or mL. Used in cooking, medicine dosing, and beverage volumes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {５|ご}{００|ひゃく}ミリリットルの{水|みず}: 500 milliliters of water
- ミリリットル{単位|たんい}で{計|はか}る: to measure in milliliters
- ミリリットル{入|い}り: containing X milliliters (on packaging)

RELATED UNITS:
- リットル: liter (L) — 1000 milliliters
- {立方|りっぽう}センチメートル (cc): cubic centimeter — numerically equal to a milliliter; common in medicine and automotive contexts
